en-US.title: Rocket Launch Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Upcoming launches and events
en-US.promoText: See upcoming rocket launches, save on-device reminders, and browse meteor showers, moon phases, and NASA's astronomy picture.
en-US.description:
Rocket Launch Tracker shows upcoming and past rocket launches from around the world, using public schedules from Launch Library 2 by The Space Devs.

Browse launches and save favorites on your iPhone. Set a reminder for a launch you care about. Reminders are notifications scheduled on this device. The app has no account and does not use remote push.

The events calendar includes meteor showers, moon phases, and asteroid close approaches. The gallery shows NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day. You can add a launch or sky event to your calendar when you choose to.

Lists are cached on your device, so a screen you have already opened can load again without a connection. When the launch service is busy, the app shows the last saved list instead of failing.

Rocket Launch Tracker is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by NASA or any launch provider.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release. Browse upcoming and past launches, save favorites, set on-device reminders, and view sky events.

review.notes: No login and no demo account. The app has no user accounts. Calendar permission is requested only on iOS 16 and earlier, and only after the reviewer taps Add to Calendar on an event. On iOS 17 and later, Add to Calendar opens the system event sheet without a prior permission prompt. Notifications are optional local reminders; the app does not use remote push and has no push entitlement. The app does not request location. Launch data is from Launch Library 2 (The Space Devs). Asteroid data and the picture gallery are from NASA's public APIs. The app is not affiliated with NASA or any launch provider. Privacy policy: https://xsuat.github.io/rocket-launch-tracker/privacy-policy.html
